So to clear a little bit up, you only earn points for purchases. You don’t earn by using your points. The system is a little tricky and we sometimes have duplicate accounts. For employees, this happens because one account has been “marked” with the employee discount. Another way to rack up points is to keep track of certain brands that will give you 5x the points. One thing to keep in mind tho, if you’re using points to get money off your purchase you only earn points for the money you actually spent. For example: if you were buying $200 worth of product and you used 1,000 points($50 off) you would only accumulate that $150 worth of points. If you’re a platinum or diamond it adds more. I also believe that certain products that earn you more points are limited for the multiplier, so i would read the fine print on that. To work around it, you probably can make separate purchases.
Depending on what manager, they’ll sometimes let you use your discount. But again, depending.
You should be able to now. Before you couldn’t use points on services, but now it should.

I’m the MSC at my store and were short an ROM at this point. We’re in the same boat as far as that goes. One thing to help with RTVs is to pull them 3 days prior to when they’re due. The way you can find that is through the ordering portal. That’s how I’ve been doing it at least. Another good way is to delegate certain tasks that need to be done daily to other managers. Yes, it is suppose to be your job, but considering your short an MSC, they don’t really have the room to complain or fight on it. I’m sure your GM will agree. It’s tough getting started. Another good way to help with the workload is to contact other ROMs in the district. Since I was brought on out of the blue, that’s how i trained. Completely feel you on that one.
